confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live booking pages or listings were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and is sensitive to July demand and the 10% service charge typical of HK hotels. FX: the 0.6947 value (2026-10-16) was read from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not from the page itself. The summary listed three values for 14 to 16 October without explicit date labels, so I took the last one as the 16 October observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: East Asia, priced in line with high-cost Asian financial hubs such as Singapore, Tokyo and Seoul. Restaurant prices reflect local cha chaan teng, casual-dining and mid-range norms. Hotel and hostel anchors reflect Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Ma Tei and Causeway Bay / Wan Chai pricing for July.
